# Collaboration handoff

Consult this reference when collaboration handoff is relevant to the selected task. Extract the specific constraint or example you need, verify version-sensitive behavior against the active toolchain, and return to the task rather than loading unrelated references.

When handing off Acrobat review work, include:
- reviewed file name and version
- compare pair used (baseline vs current)
- summary of material deltas
- open comments or blockers
- next owner and expected action (approve, revise, sign, or publish)
